label: Dagu DGServo 9g header connector
description:
Dagu DGServo 9g header connector (female)

This part represents the header plug found on the DGServo 9g. It is based on the standard female header, but is labelled to clearly indicate the ground, Vcc and pulse pins in schematic view. To use it, simply plug this part onto whichever header pins you are using, then attach the wires from a DGServo 9g part to the back of it. In schematic view, ensure this part is closer to the servo, than the header pin but further from the next component in the chain. This should route the rats nest wires the right way. In PCB view, ensure this part is off-board.
